docs/head-logic-machines/composition.mmd.title: Event-machine composition
docs/head-logic-machines/composition.mmd.description: DepositRegistry → Lifecycle → Clock. Lifecycle holds the open head’s snapshot/transaction continuation, rendered separately. Ports carry owned state projections and the deposit value before consumption.

docs/head-logic-machines/lifecycle.mmd.title: Head lifecycle
docs/head-logic-machines/lifecycle.mmd.description: Idle, Open, Closed, ReadyToFanout and fanout progress. Closed or ReadyToFanout can observe another party completing fanout and become Idle.

docs/head-logic-machines/deposits.mmd.title: Tracked deposits
docs/head-logic-machines/deposits.mmd.description: Recorded, active, expired and consumed deposits, including what rollback can restore or remove. Deposit registration is distinct from selection for a snapshot.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Leader accepts a transaction
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Ledger application succeeds; the leader records local application and requests a snapshot.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Follower accepts a transaction
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The follower applies the transaction without requesting the next round.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Transaction waits for a dependency
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Receipt survives the wait; buffered effects do not. A retry runs a fresh program against current state.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Transaction retry expires
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: An inapplicable transaction with no retry budget is invalidated.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Locally applied duplicate
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The known transaction ID is ignored before receipt or ledger application.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Transaction output collision
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The rule rejects conflicting output names; the interpreter does not own this policy.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Transaction during a snapshot round
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Local application succeeds while snapshot request selection waits for the current round.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Snapshot request succeeds
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The rule resolves transactions, constructs and signs the snapshot, buffers AckSn, then prunes local transactions.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Snapshot version mismatch
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: A future or otherwise different local version waits at the version guard.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Snapshot transaction is missing
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The request waits until the local registry contains the requested transaction.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Snapshot carries a decommit
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The decommit is applied before ordinary transactions; this order matters in the dependency bug.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Network decommit is recorded
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The network rule reserves the decommit and can broadcast ReqSn; it does not stage SnapshotRequestDecided.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Network decommit waits
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: An inapplicable decommit waits while retry budget remains.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Network decommit expires
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Without retry budget, the same failure records DecommitInvalid.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Recover a registered deposit
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Registration and retained-finalization checks pass, then the rule posts recovery.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Recover an unknown deposit
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The missing-deposit guard rejects before any post.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Recover a finalized deposit
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: A retained finalized increment blocks recovery of its resurfaced deposit.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Acknowledgement arrives early
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The acknowledgement waits for the snapshot it signs.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Partial acknowledgement
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The partial path records the signature twice. The migration preserves this observable event order.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Duplicate acknowledgement
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: An already recorded signer is rejected according to the existing acknowledgement policy.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Final acknowledgement confirms
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: A complete valid multisignature confirms the round and selects subsequent work.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Invalid final acknowledgement
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The signature is staged before aggregate verification. Verification fails, so rejection discards that staged signature and every buffered effect.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: ReqTx phases
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The typed ReqTx topology generated from crem. Actions can terminate early with a Program wait or rejection; the graph does not enumerate guards inside each phase.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: ReqSn phases
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The typed ReqSn topology generated from crem. Actions can terminate early with a Program wait or rejection; the graph does not enumerate guards inside each phase.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: AckSn phases
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The typed AckSn topology generated from crem. Actions can terminate early with a Program wait or rejection; the graph does not enumerate guards inside each phase.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: ReqDec phases
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The typed ReqDec topology generated from crem. Actions can terminate early with a Program wait or rejection; the graph does not enumerate guards inside each phase.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Recover phases
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The typed Recover topology generated from crem. Actions can terminate early with a Program wait or rejection; the graph does not enumerate guards inside each phase.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Historical invalid confirmation (v1)
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Historical fault-injected verification witness. The primitive tape format is superseded; use the v2 counterexample to replay.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Invalid confirmation under a verification fault
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The test-only interpreter bypass lets an invalid acknowledgement confirm. Replay with normal verification rejects the same sequence.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Decommit dependency failure
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Historical v1 trace of the decommit stall: snapshot 1 pruning restores the reserved input; snapshot 2 applies the decommit before tx2 and all parties reject. Use the v2 historical and corrected commands for current reproduction.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Dependency retry expires
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: A normal-interpreter schedule drains its retries before the dependency arrives. Safety holds, but pending work is stranded.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Explorer finds retry expiry
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: A focused bounded retry-window search finds the expiry schedule. The artifact records its bounds and does not establish general liveness.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Cardano witness replacement
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: A transaction with stripped witnesses shares a valid transaction body and ID. The frozen rule corrupts the registry; the duplicate guard preserves the validated payload.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Registry regression replay
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: A reproducible scheduler sequence exercises duplicate/registry handling under the corrected rule.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Historical snapshot round (v1)
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The original three-party round artifact. Its v1 primitive tape is historical; use v2 for replay.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Complete snapshot round
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: A normal three-party round with recorded primitive replies, confirmation and subsequent work.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Settlement and rollback
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Party lanes show deposit confirmation, on-chain increment, spending, rollback and re-observation. The driver checks outcomes and serialized replay at every prefix.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Original leader transaction trace
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Original transaction-slice trace: successful application followed by a leader request.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Original follower transaction trace
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Original transaction-slice trace: application without a leader request.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Original in-flight transaction trace
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Original transaction-slice trace: local work while a round is already in flight.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Original collision trace
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Original transaction-slice trace showing the output-name guard.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Original expiry trace
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Original transaction-slice trace showing invalidation after retry exhaustion.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Original dependency wait trace
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Original transaction-slice trace showing receipt retained across a wait.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Maintenance exercise
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: A deliberately changed rule guard alters execution and the generated trace without changing the interpreter.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Close adopts an unconfirmed snapshot
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The observed close carries valid signatures for the snapshot still collecting acknowledgements. Confirm it before recording HeadClosed.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Client close
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Post CloseTx using the confirmed snapshot and current version.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Connectivity input
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Admit a connectivity event and record network status.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Contest adopts an unconfirmed snapshot
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Adopt the matching signed snapshot and record the contest. Successful adoption does not post another contest.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Invalid client decommit
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: A ledger failure records DecommitInvalid without broadcasting.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Client decommit admission
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Check for a pending decommit, ask the ledger, require outputs, and broadcast ReqDec. Reservation occurs on receipt of ReqDec.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Decrement adopts the seen snapshot
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Finalize the decommit, verify the matching seen snapshot, and adopt it.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Tick activates a deposit
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The common tick prefix records time and deposit status before choosing head-specific work.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Observe deposit
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Record a deposit for the active head.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Observe recovery
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Consume a tracked deposit after its recovery is observed.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Continue driven fanout
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Record the observed batch and post the next step. An empty remainder still needs the final token-burning step.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Reject an empty fanout selection
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: An empty selection produces CommandFailed without changing the driver state.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Observe completed fanout
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Record the final distributed set and return the head to Idle.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Observe another party fanning out
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Record distributed outputs and enter AwaitingSelection. A passive observer does not take over the driver role.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Fanout initiation fails
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: A terminal failure of the current step before any outputs are distributed reverts optimistic fanout and reports the error.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Fanout deadline passes
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The tick prefix advances time before notifying readiness, once.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Start automatic fanout
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Record the driver role before posting full fanout.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Rollback during fanout
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Record rollback and repost the currently driven step, without recording a new selection.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Select the whole remaining fanout
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: A selection covering the complete closed head uses full fanout rather than an invalid final-partial transaction.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Fanout post is superseded
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: StalePartialFanoutTx is ignored because chain observation already advances the head.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Increment adopts the seen snapshot
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Finalize the deposit, verify the matching seen snapshot, then adopt it before choosing subsequent work.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Increment with invalid adoption signatures
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Finalization is still recorded. Failed verification prevents snapshot adoption without undoing the chain observation.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Observe init
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Match the observed parties, participants and periods before opening the head.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Client init
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Admit a client Init while Idle and buffer the configured on-chain init.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Complete input phases
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Size admission precedes synchronisation. Typed head-state payloads enter Idle, Open, Closed or FanoutProgress dispatch.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Rollback in an open head
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Record rollback and evaluate retained settlement reposting without undoing L2 state.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Recover a previous head deposit
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: A recovery event consumes a previous head deposit while a different head is active. The event is exempt from the head-ID filter; the differential test checks the resulting registry.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Side-load the current snapshot
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Check number and L1 fields, verify the multisignature, then confirm and clear optimistic local state.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Side-load with invalid signatures
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The field checks pass but verification fails. The existing client rejection is emitted; no state changes are staged.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Chain input while catching up
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Chain observations pass the synchronisation gate and update the head.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Client input while catching up
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: After the size check, synchronisation rejects the client input with the existing drift report.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Network input while catching up
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Connectivity events follow the same existing wait policy as other network inputs.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Client decommit phases
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Pending work, ledger result, output check and broadcast are separate typed phases.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Settlement phases
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Record finalization, choose a candidate, verify it, and select work at the new version. Verification failure still reaches request selection.

docs/head-logic-machines/coordinated.mmd.title: Snapshot and transaction owners
docs/head-logic-machines/coordinated.mmd.description: Generated from the executable Snapshots → Transactions composition. Typed ports carry rebases, settlement and clearing. A fresh decrement releases a reservation; a repeated observation preserves it. Reserved means a decommit is recorded, not that every ledger property holds. Live requests require a checked proposal and start only from AwaitingRequest; the CollectingSignatures to RequestSent edge exists for trusted event replay.

docs/head-logic-machines/decommit-owners.title: Decommit failure at the owner boundary
docs/head-logic-machines/decommit-owners.description: Historical failure, grouped by rules, snapshot owner, transaction owner and independent audit. Rebase restores a reserved input, then a leader proposes a decommit before its dependency is confirmed. The corrected execution appears below.

docs/head-logic-machines/decommit-correc.title: Decommit dependency correction
docs/head-logic-machines/decommit-correc.description: The corrected rule preserves the reservation, confirms dependencies in snapshot 2, then starts decommit-only snapshot 3. A carried decommit alone does not start another round. This annotated diagram explains the generated execution traces.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Historical decommit dependency failure
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The frozen implementation loses the reservation and rejects snapshot 2 after 24 deliveries. This v2 report checks complete outcomes and serialized state at every prefix.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Corrected decommit dependency sequence
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Production execution preserves the reservation, confirms tx2 in snapshot 2, then confirms the decommit in snapshot 3. Every emitted message is delivered and both independent checks hold at every prefix.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Oversized snapshot request before rebase
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Historical production trace at 386e95947: the split records a request, ReqSn rejects for capacity, and the later merge cannot request another round. The rejection cannot undo the preceding completed input. The capacity lab now reproduces the defect with frozen programs.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Historical capacity stall
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: Frozen programs accept the split and independent merge locally, but the oversized snapshot 4 request is rejected everywhere. Nine FIFO deliveries leave snapshot 3 confirmed and the leader stuck.

docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.title: Capacity pruning and progress
docs/docs/dev/architecture/head-logic-ex.description: The current rules request empty snapshot 4, prune the overflowing split, then confirm the independent merge in snapshot 5. Each delivery checks independent invariants and serialized replay; a capacity check precedes the live request marker.
